fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, so no owner took part. The planner found that the systemd unit's ExecStart and the Rex tab already start rhiza with the same daemonArgs (daemon --autonomous) since #200, and both scripts check it. The one real difference between service and tab is the environment: daemon install writes no PATH or TMPDIR, and the VM works only because of a hand-written drop-in. The planner asked the arbiter for the scope. The arbiter ruled (Decision daemon-service-env-matches-tab, assumed) that the leaves cover the environment: daemon install writes the installing shell's PATH and TMPDIR into the unit as Environment= lines. The shared args get no leaf of their own. The change set serves milestone-25, relates to the leafless draft 01M6FN21KA287N, and that draft is withdrawn.
fields.title: Plan of 'The daemon behaves the same' (autonomous, arbiter)
